The 07layouts test in mdadm fails on some systems. The failure
presents itself as the backup file not being removed before the next
layout is grown into:
mdadm: /dev/md0: cannot create backup file /tmp/md-test-backup:
File exists
This is because the background mdadm process
cleaning up this backup file gets into an infinite loop waiting for
the reshape to start. mdadm checks the mdstat file if a reshape is
going and
column3: it waits for an event on the file or times

column1: out in 5 seconds. On faster machines
the 5 seconds times out
column2: and thus the background mdadm process loops

column1: waiting for a reshape to start that has already occurred.
mdadm reads the mdstat file to start
column2: but mdstat does not report that the

column1: reshape has begun
column2: even though it has indeed begun. So the mdstat_wait()

column1: call (in mdadm) which polls on the mdstat file won't ever return until
timing out.
The reason mdstat reports the reshape has started is due to an issue
in status_resync(). recovery_active is subtracted from curr_resync which
will result in a value of zero for the first chunk of reshaped data
the resulting read will report no reshape in progress.
To fix this
column2: if ""resync - recovery_active"" is an overloaded value

column1: the value to be MD_RESYNC_ACTIVE so the code reports a resync in progress.
